login.title: Naatgol gollodiiɗo kanaal
login.welcome: On njaraama! Naat ngam ƴellitde ardaade maa.
login.heroTitle: Mawnin njulaagu maa e kala ardorde nde ngaddataa
login.heroIntro: Portal gooto ngam winnditaade soodooɓe e mahooɓe, jogaade credit ngam ardaade ma e rewde ɓe haa booking.

register.title: Winndito ardaade e nder leƴƴanɗe
register.text: Waɗde soodoowo maa e eɓɓoore nde ɓe njiɗi.

protect.title: Reende duppitgol
protect.text: Ardorde maa ina heddii e maa e nder dumunna ndeenka, ko ɗuum waɗi hay gooto goɗɗo waawaa ɗaɓɓude soodoowo gooto.

track.title: Rewta kala daawal
track.text: Ƴeew ngonka kala ardotooɗo e daartol mum timmungol, gila e jokkondiral gadanal haa e jokkondire.

handover.title: Kredit e deftere
handover.text: So soodoowo deftere, ardaade ina rokketee mahoowo oo tawa aɗa winnditoo wonde gollodiiɗo source.

login.secure: Naatgol kisal - kabaruuji soodooɓe maa ina keddii e sirlu

signup.title: Winnditaade gollodiiɓe Kanaal
signup.intro: Sos konte maa ngam fuɗɗaade winnditaade e ƴellitde ardiiɓe maa.
